settings.heading: How do I place an order?
settings.row_content: Simply choose your meals on our website, add them to your cart, and check out. Once the order is submitted, you’ll receive confirmation with all your details.

settings.heading: Do you change your menu?
settings.row_content: Yes. Chef Matt regularly updates the menu based on seasonal ingredients, premium local produce, and his diverse culinary background — from French training to globally inspired flavors.

settings.heading: What kind of meals do you offer?
settings.row_content: We offer handcrafted, chef-prepared meals focused on clean, fresh, flavorful food. Ingredients include premium proteins, some organic produce, gluten-free options, and locally sourced items whenever possible. Meals are designed to be healthy, delicious, and easy to enjoy at home.

settings.heading: How are the meals packaged?
settings.row_content: Meals come fully prepared in high-quality containers with a 24 oz portion size designed to keep food fresh and easy to heat. Every dish is cooked in small batches for maximum flavor and consistency.

settings.heading: How do I heat the meals?
settings.row_content: Meals are delivered fresh and fully cooked. Most dishes can be microwaved in just a few minutes. Remove any sauce cups before heating and warm until hot throughout.

settings.heading: Can I freeze the meals?
settings.row_content: Meals stay fresh in the fridge for up to several days. If needed, you can freeze them for longer storage. For best results, thaw completely and reheat thoroughly before eating.

settings.heading: When will my meals be delivered?
settings.row_content: Meals are delivered every Monday between 10:00 AM – 2:00 PM. Orders must be placed before the weekly Friday 11:59 PM cutoff. A delivery logistics fee may apply depending on your location.

settings.heading: Do you deliver to my area?
settings.row_content: We currently serve Hartland 📍 Delafield 📍 Pewaukee 📍 Waukesha 📍 Sussex 📍 Merton 📍 Nashotah 📍 Okauchee Lake 📍 Oconomowoc 📍 Oconomowoc Lake 📍 Chenequa 📍 Lisbon 📍 Lannon 📍 Menomonee Falls 📍 Brookfield 📍 Elm Grove 📍 Wales 📍 Dousman 📍 Summit 📍 Lake Country 📍 Stone Bank 📍 North Lake 📍 Mapleton 📍 Genesee 📍 Mukwonago.
